import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem amc12a_2002_p21
  (u S : ℕ → ℕ)
  (h₀ : u 0 = 4)
  (h₁ : u 1 = 7)
  (h₂ : ∀ n ≥ 2, u n = (u (n - 2) + u (n - 1)) % 10)
  (h₃ : ∀ n, S n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, u k)
  (Sn : Set ℕ)
  (h₄ : Sn = {n | S n > 10000}) :
  IsLeast Sn 1999 := by
  constructor
  · rw [h₄]
    change S 1999 > 10000
    rw [h₃]
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, h₂, h₀, h₁]
  · intro n hn
    rw [h₄] at hn
    change S n > 10000 at hn
    by_contra h
    have hnlt : n < 1999 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge h
    have hnle : n ≤ 1998 := by omega
    have hs : S n ≤ S 1998 := by
      rw [h₃ n, h₃ 1998]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · exact Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hnle
      · intro i hi his
        exact Nat.zero_le _
    have hs2 : S 1998 ≤ 10000 := by
      rw [h₃]
      set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
        norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, h₂, h₀, h₁]
    omega
